Hi all — looping in legal. Thanks for the helpful draft, Jane. We can accommodate a mutual announcement with limited carveouts; below is the language we are requesting be added to the Order Form / MSA as an explicit publicity clause (redline suggestion attached). Please confirm acceptance or suggest edits.

Proposed publicity & confidentiality carveout (for insertion into Order Form):

"Publicity. Customer and Redwood may mutually agree to the public disclosure of the relationship and a one-time announcement describing the collaboration. Such announcement may include: (a) a two-sentence quote attributed to a named Redwood representative; and (b) Redwood's logo used only in connection with the announcement on Customer-controlled domains and marketing materials. Customer shall provide Redwood with the final press release and any draft marketing assets at least five (5) business days prior to publication for Redwood's review and trademark compliance. No additional rights to use Redwood's trademarks, logos or product names are granted beyond the scope and term of the announced publication (not to exceed six (6) months from publication)."

Confidentiality note: the above does not waive any confidentiality obligations in the MSA related to pricing, non-public technical details, or customer data; those sections remain in full force.

Attachments: redline_clause_suggestion.txt (contains snippet and placement guidance).

Next steps: If Customer accepts the language we will incorporate it into the attached redline (David's file) and return a DocuSign-ready Order Form. If you need a shorter turnaround, we can accept a 24-hour preview review instead of five business days but will require a final sign-off before publication.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
